LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Dawnblade.label: Dawnblade
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Dawnblade.description:
MPQFS-85 "Dawnblade" is an onboard multirole quick-firing cannon system. It uses drum magazines and an automatic revolver loader to permit a high rate of sustained fire.
The armor plating has been removed to allow emplacement to be redeployed as needed for heavy fire support.

LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Sentry.label: Sentry turret
LanguageData.DMS_Turret_Sentry.description: A light automatic turret with a built-in battery, designed to be carried and set up wherever the line needs a gun. On the power grid it charges its internal cell; cut off from the grid it draws on that reserve and keeps firing until the cell runs dry. Switching it off puts it on standby: it stops watching and pours the saved power into the cell instead, charging twice as fast.\n\nIts tripod folds flat, so a drafted operator can pick it up, carry it forward and drop it into position on the spot. A cell charged before departure will keep it standing watch for days.
